title: Rating
summary: A whole-star rating input (radios underneath), and a compact read-only display form.

props.name: readonly
props.description: The display form: not interactive, exposed as an image with a text alternative.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-rating-change
events.description: The user changed the value (same moment as change; carries it).

a11y: An input rating is a radio group: each star is named "3 stars", arrow keys change the value and focus is visible. The read-only form is role=img with "4 out of 5 stars". Stars are 44px on a phone.
